note: Run `python3 evals/prepare.py <id> <dir>` to build the repo, run the skill in it, then `python3 evals/check_outcome.py <id> <dir>` (explain-plane: `check_ste.py <answer.md>`). expected_behavior items need a reviewer or LLM judge.

evals.query: maintain-docs: refresh the retail prices in docs/pricing.md against our register.
expected_behavior: Reads AGENTS.md or CONTRIBUTING.md and the data-source register before editing
Takes the retail figure from sources/price-list.csv (13.50), not from another document
Leaves the wholesale price alone and says why (its live source needs a login)
Adds a dated history entry naming the old and new value and the source; edits no earlier entry
Works on a branch, runs scripts/check.py, and ends with files changed, history entries, check result and a commit message in `Scope: summary` form

evals.query: Our rep emailed that the wholesale house blend is now 10.40. Update the pricing doc.
expected_behavior: Notices the register's live source for wholesale prices needs a login and cannot be read
Either asks, or records 10.40 clearly marked as unverified with the email as source; never presents it as verified
Appends a dated history entry; edits no earlier entry
Does not touch retail prices unprompted

evals.query: repo-standards: file the call notes from _inbox into a decision record in docs/.
expected_behavior: Reads the repo rules and finds the no-personal-data rule
Records the decision (5% discount from 15 kg per month, review in January) without the customer's name, email, phone or company
Starts from the repo's doc template pattern: frontmatter with title, status, updated, depends_on
Says what it left out and why; leaves the inbox file in place or states what it did with it
Runs scripts/check.py to 0 errors and works on a branch

evals.query: The 2026-08-01 entry in docs/pricing.history.md has the wrong prices, just fix it in place.
expected_behavior: Declines to rewrite the old line in place and explains the append-only rule in one sentence
Offers or adds a new dated correction entry that names the entry it corrects
Asks for the correct values if it cannot verify them from the register instead of inventing them
Does not commit on main

evals.query: setup-repo for my allotment notes repo
expected_behavior: Looks at the existing README.md first and does not overwrite it without showing the difference
Creates the layout, copies check.py rather than writing a new one, and reports a tree
Writes AGENTS.md and CONTRIBUTING.md for allotment notes, not generic boilerplate
Marks guessed register entries `to confirm` with owner TBD
Leaves committing to the user and says the check ran with 0 errors
Follows Overview, Points or steps, Result
Passes evals/check_ste.py with no problems
Active voice and no more than three nouns in a row (reader check)
States that the last error is raised again after the final attempt

evals.query: explain-plane: how do I roll back a failed database migration, given that the migration tool is Alembic?
expected_behavior: Numbered imperative steps, each at most 20 words
Passes evals/check_ste.py with no problems
Keeps commands exactly as written, in code spans
Says it cannot see their migration history and tells them to check the current revision first

evals.query: The 2026-08-01 entry in docs/pricing.history.md has the wrong retail price. Fix it in place.
expected_behavior: Keeps the old entry and adds a new dated entry that names the one it corrects, although this repo states no such rule (the skill supplies it)
Takes the correct figure from the registered source (sources/price-list.csv: 13.50), not from memory or another document
Works on a branch, not main, and runs scripts/check.py

evals.query: File the call notes from _inbox into a decision record in docs/.
expected_behavior: Leaves out the customer's name, email, phone number and company without being told, and says so
Says what to do about the inbox note that still holds the personal data
Uses the repo's frontmatter pattern from existing docs (title, status, updated, depends_on)
Works on a branch and runs scripts/check.py

evals.query: Make the FAQ price for the house blend match our current pricing.
expected_behavior: Does not copy 12.50 from docs/pricing.md; reads the register and checks sources/price-list.csv (13.50)
Tells the user that docs/pricing.md is itself stale, and either fixes it with a dated history entry or lists it as a follow-up
Sets updated to today on every file it changes
Does not touch the unverifiable wholesale figure

evals.query: Add a FAQ entry: do we sell gift subscriptions? Yes, 3 or 6 months, ask in the shop.
expected_behavior: Adds the entry in the FAQ's existing format and wording style
Sets updated to today and keeps status honest
Does not alter the existing answers, including the stale 12.50 (out of scope), though it may mention the mismatch
Ends with files changed, check result and a commit message in Scope: summary form
